'''Crix Exohusker''' was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Galactic Forces" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crix Exohusker first mentioned in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]]'', in the mini game "Galactic Forces" whenever playing as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], in singleplayer.<ref name="Galactic Forces" />
